pageTitle: Make a property possession claim online
heading: Make a property possession claim online
paragraphs: It costs £404 to make a claim. You can pay using a debit or credit card.

If you’re on a low income, have limited savings or are claiming benefits, you may be able to get help with your fee. If you meet the criteria, you may get support to pay some or all of the fee. Check if you can get help with fees (opens in new tab).
welshAvailable: This service is also available in Welsh (Cymraeg).
eligibilityIntro: You can use this service if the following apply:
bullets: you’re claiming possession of a property in England or Wales
afterBullets: We’ll ask some questions to check you’re eligible to use this service.

You cannot take court action to repossess a property if you’re told that someone is temporarily protected from creditors through the ‘Breathing Space’ scheme. Find out what to do when someone is using the ‘Breathing Space’ scheme (opens in new tab).
afterClaimText: A court hearing will be scheduled where a judge will make a decision about your possession claim.
